name: background-v2
prompt: Make two precise changes only to this approved pixel-art cafe background. 1: Inside the existing brass hanging sign above the doorway, paint exact Korean text '방 선택하기' as modest flat warm-ivory pixel lettering, engraved/painted into the dark sign surface. NO 3D extrusion, NO glow, NO floating UI text. 2: Remove the RIGHTMOST gear poster and its little picture light above the reception desk; fill that rectangle with continuous same warm-gray plaster wall. name: leaderboard-main
prompt: Edit this single pixel-art physical leaderboard sign. Preserve its precise silhouette, walnut, brass and matte charcoal materials. name: calendar
prompt: Create a pixel-art WALL CALENDAR animation atlas matching this mature walnut warm-grey escape cafe lobby. Exactly six cells arranged 3 columns by 2 rows, each 512x512, total1536x1024. Each cell identical fixed-size wall-mounted walnut backing with two small brass binder clips at top and parchment calendar sheet. Header on wooden top backing has modest flat engraved Korean text '진척도' (never floating or extruded). Below it a fine printed 7-column calendar grid, small date marks, a few muted olive stamps. Fine real pixel detail like reference, dimensional paper edges, restrained light from upper left. Frame 1 rest. Frames2-5 ONLY bottom-right corner of ONE sheet curls upward and over, passing left across page. Frame6 new calendar page rests flat. Backing, binder, title, upper sheet edge, position and scale EXACTLY fixed across all cells. Actual transparent background outside object. No shadow halos, no wall or scene. No frame numbers, no grid dividers. Fully opaque object interiors. Do not make a UI icon: a believable physical pinned calendar with natural paper texture.
